# SVG_PAGE_EXPORT_DEFAULTS

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Default values applied when an option is omitted.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Properties

- [`embedImages`](#embedimages): How raster images should be represented.
- [`includeAccessibilityMetadata`](#includeaccessibilitymetadata): Include `<title>`, `<desc>`, `role`, and `aria-label` on the root `<svg>` element.
- [`precision`](#precision): Decimal places for generated coordinates.
- [`shapeRendering`](#shaperendering): Value for the root `shape-rendering` attribute.

### `embedImages`

```typescript
embedImages: "omit" | "data-uri" | "external-ref"
```

How raster images should be represented. `data-uri` (default) is best for standalone website thumbnails - the SVG carries the image bytes inline and needs no asset coordination. `omit` drops images entirely.

### `includeAccessibilityMetadata`

```typescript
includeAccessibilityMetadata: boolean
```

Include `<title>`, `<desc>`, `role`, and `aria-label` on the root `<svg>` element. This is a lightweight preview affordance, not PDF/UA structure export. Defaults to true.

### `precision`

```typescript
precision: number
```

Decimal places for generated coordinates. Defaults to 3 for stable, compact output.

### `shapeRendering`

```typescript
shapeRendering: "crispEdges" | "auto" | "optimizeSpeed" | "geometricPrecision"
```

Value for the root `shape-rendering` attribute. Defaults to `auto` (the SVG default), which keeps antialiased curves/charts looking smooth. Set to `crispEdges` for pages dominated by pixel-grid graphics (barcodes, QR, Data Matrix) so abutting module rectangles snap to the device pixel grid and don't leave faint anti-aliasing seams between modules. Text is governed by `text-rendering`, so it is unaffected either way.
